items.title: Browns go for first sweep of Steelers since 1988
items.text: When the Browns visit the Steelers today, first place in the AFC North is on the line between the pair of 5-2 teams.

items.title: Jets WR Omar Cooper Jr. has two straight games with 100-plus yards and a touchdown

items.title: Mike Macdonald hasn't committed to Jadarian Price playing on Monday
items.text: When the Seahawks' final injury report, issued on Saturday, had both running back Zach Charbonnet and running back Jadarian Price free from any designation for Monday night's game against the Bears, it created the impression that both will play.

items.title: Eagles reportedly won't trade Saquon Barkley
items.text: At a time when some believe the Eagles are in a soft tank, their subtle effort to secure better round-by-round draft position in 2027 won't include getting an extra draft pick or two for running back Saquon Barkley.

items.title: The new allegations against Josh Jacobs could create a credibility issue

items.title: Josh Allen going for his 102nd win counting playoffs, more than Tom Brady's first 9 seasons
items.text: If Allen and the Bills win today, he'll surpass Brady for sole possession of the third-most wins in a quarterback's first nine seasons.

items.title: With 88 yards on Sunday, Derrick Henry will jump to No. 7 all-time in rushing yards
items.text: Ravens running back Derrick Henry, who turns 33 in early January, continues to get it done at a high level.

items.title: As Eagles prepare for Sunday night, questions of effort from Monday night linger

items.title: Jets put DT T'Vondre Sweat on IR
items.text: The Jets ruled defensive tackle T'Vondre Sweat out for Week 8 on Friday and they ruled him out for at least three more games on Saturday.

items.title: Seahawks RBs Zach Charbonnet, Jadarian Price will return Monday night
items.text: The Seahawks will have veteran running back Zach Charbonnet and rookie running back Jadarian Price in the same game for the first time on Monday.

items.title: Deion Sanders and Colorado survive in overtime for first Big 12 win of the season
items.text: It was harder than it should have been, but Colorado and coach Deion Sanders finally have their first Big 12 win of the season, beating Kansas State 27-24 in overtime to snap a five-game losing streak.
